stubs.service: Other outbound HTTP (favicon proxy, Jina reader, Podscribe transcripts, Umami analytics)
stubs.how: offline-preload.cjs makes DNS resolution (dns.lookup and dns.promises.lookup) fail immediately with ENOTFOUND for every non-localhost host, and makes global fetch to non-localhost hosts fail fast. This matters: the favicon proxy and original-article fetch resolve DNS themselves and then connect via undici, and when DNS answers but connections are refused (EPERM), the unhandled TLS socket error crashed the server. With resolution failing first, every caller takes its normal fallback path: /favicons returns the app's 1x1 fallback, which the UI turns into letter icons, and the original-article fetch returns a handled 422. Umami is disabled (UMAMI_WEBSITE_ID empty). stubs/test-offline-dns-sim.cjs is a test-only helper that simulates 'DNS works, connections refused' to verify this; start.sh does not load it.
Local email+password admin seeded from ADMIN_EMAIL/ADMIN_PASSWORD (app's own mechanism). AI OAuth (ChatGPT/Codex) left disabled.
